Name: Yuzu More Craftables
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[font=Courier New][b][color=#ea9999][size=5]Yuzu More Craftables[/size][/color][/b]
[b][size=4]Supports Cornucopia and Wildflour.[/size][/b][/font]


[size=4][font=Courier New][b]Adds shared crafting equipment for Yuzu’s More food series.
Use alongside [color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Ingredients[/color], then choose the food mods you want. You don’t need to install the entire series.
Some recipes use ingredients from [color=#ffd966]Cornucopia [/color][color=#efefef]and[/color][color=#ffd966] Wildflour’s Atelier Goods[/color]. Check each food mod’s requirements before installing.[/b]
[/font][/size]


[b][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Courier New]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/color]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Download and unzip the file.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Courier New]Keep the folder structure as it is.
[u][color=#ff0000]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/color][/u][/font][/size][/b][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: More Craftables Core
Manifest.Description: Limits shrimp trap placement to the Secret Woods and produces daily catches.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17

Manifest.Name: More Craftables
Manifest.Description: Adds the antique roaster and Secret Woods shrimp trap.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu
